title: Balanced Cashew and Veggie Curry
subtitle: with Brown Rice and Spinach
description: Wholesome is the name of the game for this sweet potato and spinach curry with brown rice. Infused with fresh lemongrass and topped with golden cashews, there's flavour in spades too.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Fill a medium saucepan three-quarters full with water and bring to the boil for the rice. Thinly slice 2 garlic cloves. Peel the sweet potatoes, then cut into 2cm chunks. Trim the spinach, then cut into thirds.

Make lemongrass rice: Trim the lemongrass stem, then remove the tough outer layers (see Kitchen 101). Press down on the stem with the flat side of a knife or a rolling pin to release the oils, then halve the stem lengthwise. Cook the rice and half the lemongrass in the pan of boiling water for 25 mins or until the rice is tender. Drain, discarding the lemongrass.

Fry garlic: Meanwhile, heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the garlic, stirring, for 1-2 mins until golden. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towel. Return the pan to medium heat. Cook two-thirds of the curry paste, stirring, for 2 mins or until fragrant.

Cook curry: Add the sweet potato, cashews and remaining lemongrass to the pan and stir to combine. Add the coconut milk and 250ml (1 cup) water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium, cover and cook, stirring occasionally, for 15 mins or until the sweet potato is tender.

Serve up: Add the spinach, 2 tsp soy sauce and 1 tsp sugar to the curry. Cook for 2 mins or until the spinach is wilted. Remove and discard the lemongrass. Divide the lemongrass rice and veggie curry among bowls, scatter over the fried garlic and enjoy.

Kitchen 101: The white, or lower, part of the lemongrass stem has the most flavour. To prepare the lemongrass, trim off the base, then peel off the first few outer layers, as you would peel a spring onion, to get to the tender inner part of the stem.
